title: Make waitlist signup reject invalid addresses consistently
prompt:
Evidence: src/app/api/v1/waitlist/route.ts:6-15 accepts any value with an includes method and an @ sign, then lowercases and trims it. A string such as "@" or "a@" passes, while a JSON object or number reaches the catch and produces a 500 at lines 44-49. The public GET description at lines 53-58 says email is a required string. Users submitting a typo can get a successful signup even though the address is unusable, and malformed clients see an apparent server outage.

Change only src/app/api/v1/waitlist/route.ts among production files. Validate the parsed body and require a nonempty string email with a practical address shape after trim; normalize it once before the insert. Reject invalid or non-string email with 400 and do not call the database. Preserve the duplicate signup response and source default. Distinguish invalid JSON from a persistence failure so database errors remain 500. Add tests/waitlist-email-validation.test.mjs with malformed types, whitespace/case normalization, invalid addresses, duplicate entry, and storage failure cases. Run node --test tests/waitlist-email-validation.test.mjs and npm test. Work on the assigned branch you are on.
